rec.name: PDP Product Image Badges (Top-Right Overlay Labels)
rec.status: Built — launched (merged into live theme, Strawanza store)

what.text: Small text badges (e.g. "New", "Bestseller", "swaggy", or "Stretch fit" / "Seamless") overlaid in the top-right corner of the main product image on the PDP, stacked vertically as compact pills. They can also appear on collection pages. The styling was modelled on the Smilodox store.

why.text: Badges surface key product attributes and social-proof signals ("Bestseller", "New") at a glance, directly on the image where attention is highest. They help shoppers qualify the product quickly (fit, material, popularity) and reduce hesitation. Muted, small styling keeps them informative without covering the product. This reasoning is inferred, not stated in the ticket.

how.text: Implemented as a theme-level Product Badges settings group (in the Sectionfy-based theme) that controls the badge styling. Badge content is assigned per product (likely via tags or metafields, unconfirmed). Badges render absolutely positioned at the top-right of the product media, stacked with a small gap. Styling: white background, dark-grey text (#2E2E2E), 12px font, 3px corner radius, optional uppercase. Toggles hide the badges on collection pages or on the product page. Merged into the live theme on 2025-11-19 after the client asked for a Smilodox-style look.

dependencies.text: Sectionfy-based theme with a Product Badges settings group. The source of badge text per product (tags, metafields or an app) is not stated in the ticket. Needs product images in a gallery to overlay on.

items: Conversion rate for badged vs. non-badged products

images.caption: Smilodox-style reference: two small badges ("Stretch fit", "Seamless") in the top-right of the product image, circled in yellow.
Final implementation on the Strawanza PDP: stacked "New", "Bestseller", "swaggy" badges top-right of the image, with the theme editor's Product Badges settings panel on the left.
